basic_info.description: This all new ground-up luxury construction (2025), two-story townhome is located just moments away from the Castro shopping, gyms, dining, entertainment, tech shuttles and all major transit. From the tree lined street, the building's classic facade fits well into this highly coveted neighborhood. Upon entering, you'll be greeted by a bright, modern open floor plan with extra height ceilings and doors. The large windows overlook a courtyard garden landscaped with low maintenance trees and shrubs. The well appointed kitchen has ample cabinetry, built-in paneled fridge, Bosch dishwasher and a gas range. The bathroom has design grade fixtures, finishes and the space feels spacious and spa-like. Additional features include an in-unit full size Whirlpool washer & dryer, radiant floor heating, tankless hot water system, indoor sprinklers, skylight, DoorBird Entry System, ADT Home Security, drip irrigation for outdoor plants and trees and very low HOA's.
